column7: TransferSecretOwnership changed only the secret's owner_id, leaving ShareRecord.OwnerID on the previous owner: they kept listing shares they could not revoke or update, the new owner the reverse. The shares are now re-stamped in the same transaction (every row, revoked and expired included, owner_id only), and CreateShareRecord re-checks the secret's owner after its FOR SHARE lock so a share authorised by the previous owner cannot commit with the old stamp. Found in the #3018 review
